Class ProductStatusMessages

java.lang.Object
ecmwf.ecpds.master.plugin.http.controller.monitoring.ProductStatusMessages
public final class ProductStatusMessages extends Object
ECMWF Product Data Store (OpenECPDS) Project Holds the built-in default text and the encoding logic for the two configurable product-status notification messages ("Products Delay" and "Products Resumed") shown as pre-filled Outlook email bodies on the product monitoring page (product.jsp). The actual, possibly customized, text is stored in the SYS_CONFIG database table (group "ProductStatus") and edited from the Monitor UI (Admin Tasks → Product Status Messages), instead of being hardcoded in the JSP page.

Both messages support the {{PRODUCT}} and {{CYCLE}} placeholders, substituted at render time with the product name and cycle/time currently being viewed (e.g. "GENFO" and "06" for /do/monitoring/summary/GENFO/06).

  • Method Details

    • substitutePlaceholders

      public static String substitutePlaceholders(String text, String product, String cycle)
      Replaces the {{PRODUCT}} and {{CYCLE}} placeholders, if present, with the actual product name and cycle/time currently being viewed (e.g. "GENFO" and "06" for /do/monitoring/summary/GENFO/06). The {{DESCRIPTION}} placeholder, if present, is replaced with an empty string.
      Parameters:
      text - the plain-text message, possibly containing placeholders
      product - the product name to substitute for PRODUCT_PLACEHOLDER
      cycle - the cycle/time to substitute for CYCLE_PLACEHOLDER
      Returns:
      the message with placeholders replaced

    • substitutePlaceholders

      public static String substitutePlaceholders(String text, String product, String cycle, String description)
      Replaces the {{PRODUCT}}, {{CYCLE}} and {{DESCRIPTION}} placeholders, if present, with the actual product name, cycle/time and configured product description currently being viewed (e.g. "GENFO" and "06" for /do/monitoring/summary/GENFO/06).
      Parameters:
      text - the plain-text message, possibly containing placeholders
      product - the product name to substitute for PRODUCT_PLACEHOLDER
      cycle - the cycle/time to substitute for CYCLE_PLACEHOLDER
      description - the product description to substitute for DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER, or null if none has been configured (substituted with an empty string in that case)
      Returns:
      the message with placeholders replaced

    • encodeForEmailBody

      public static String encodeForEmailBody(String text)
      Encodes a plain-text message for embedding as the body parameter of the Outlook Web deeplink URL used to pre-fill the "Products Delay"/"Products Resumed" emails. Only the characters that are unsafe or meaningful in that URL are percent-encoded (comma, angle brackets, double quote, colon, slash, and newlines); everything else (including spaces) is left as-is, matching the encoding historically used for these two messages.
      Parameters:
      text - the plain-text message
      Returns:
      the encoded message, ready to be embedded in the deeplink URL
